name: 保罗·艾伦
bio_short: 美国商业巨头、计算机先驱，与比尔·盖茨共同创立了微软。他具有敏锐的技术洞察力，是那个发现MITS Altair潜力并以此开启微机软件革命的人。在MS-DOS的交易中，正是他主导了以5万美元收购QDOS系统的关键谈判，为微软赢得了PC时代的入场券。
bio_short_en: American business magnate, computer pioneer, and co-founder of Microsoft. Possessing keen technical insight, he was the one who spotted the potential of the MITS Altair, sparking the microcomputer software revolution. In the MS-DOS deal, he orchestrated the critical acquisition of QDOS for $50,000, securing Microsoft's entry ticket to the PC era.
